text: Entry Requirements 18 to 25 years old. Senior high school diploma or equivalent for university application. Overall score ≥ 70% (total 100%). Biology, Chemistry and Math: > 70%. English (for students who are from non-English-speaking countries/regions): IELTS overall score≥6.0 or TOEFL overall score≥80. Pakistan HSSC transcript（pre-medical group）overall score ≥ 750/1100 or 800/1200.
